name: Starland Summer Break Rec Program
description_short: Summer recreation program at Starland Sportsplex and Fun Park in Hanover for ages 5 to 11, open to kids from any town. Days run 9 to 4 (half days to 12:30) with sports on indoor courts and turf, fun park rides such as mini golf and go karts, crafts and nature walks; lunch is included.
refund_policy_summary: 50% refund with 72 hours notice, or full credit toward another day; no refund with less than 24 hours notice. If Starland cancels, a prorated credit is given.

sessions.name: Summer Break Rec Program (book by day or week)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Rec Program page: ages 5 to 11, 9 to 4, half day $60, full day $85, full week $349, early drop off 8am or late pick up 5pm $15. Lunch included (weekly menu), snacks for purchase. Open to families from any town. The 26-27 school year calendar lists Summer Break June 14 to September 8 with a Summer Break Rec Program registration link; the session is that span at the full week price. price_min is the half day rate. Address from the page footer.

source.title: Recreation Program for Kids in Hanover, MA and the South Shore | Starland

for_andrew: The page's 26-27 school year calendar lists 'Summer Break Jun 14 to Sep 8' with a Summer Break Rec Program sign up, so I set season 2027. The prices on the page carry no year (the page also has a '2026 Update' note). Are the posted prices good for summer 2027, or wait for a dated summer listing?

The program is booked by the day or week, not in fixed sessions, so I recorded the summer break span as one session at the $349 week rate. The same program also runs on school vacation and no school days; only the summer is listed.
